name: OpenCode
run-name: "OpenCode #${{ github.event.issue.number || inputs.issue_number }}${{ github.event.issue.title && format(' — {0}', github.event.issue.title) || '' }}"

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue_number:
        description: Existing issue to run
        required: true
        type: string

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: opencode-issue-${{ github.repository }}-${{ github.event.issue.number || inputs.issue_number }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  prepare:
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || (github.event.action == 'opened' && contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'OpenCode'))
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
      issues: write
      actions: write
    uses: denaidark/OhMyGithub/.github/workflows/opencode-prepare.yml@d03e70e4b4d53ca7328a722339ebb180aa991c88
    with:
      runtime_ref: d03e70e4b4d53ca7328a722339ebb180aa991c88

  opencode:
    needs: prepare
    if: needs.prepare.outputs.approved == 'true'
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
      issues: write
      actions: read
      pull-requests: write
    uses: denaidark/OhMyGithub/.github/workflows/opencode-reusable.yml@d03e70e4b4d53ca7328a722339ebb180aa991c88
    with:
      runtime_ref: d03e70e4b4d53ca7328a722339ebb180aa991c88
      issue_number: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.issue_number }}
      request: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.request }}
      issue_title: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.issue_title }}
      labels_json: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.labels_json }}
      sender: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.sender }}
      target_ref: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.target_ref }}
      target_sha: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.target_sha }}
    secrets:
      OPENCODE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENCODE_API_KEY }}
      OPENCODE_AUTH_JSON: ${{ secrets.OPENCODE_AUTH_JSON }}
      AGENTSWEB_SSH_PUBLIC_KEY: ${{ secrets.AGENTSWEB_SSH_PUBLIC_KEY }}
      OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}

import { existsSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs'
import { resolve, join, extname } from 'node:path'
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'
import { createServer } from 'node:http'
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process'
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'

import { livePreviewScript, watchProject } from './live-preview.mjs'

export function projectType(root) {
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'package.json'))) {
    const p = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'), 'utf8'))
    if (p.dependencies?.next || p.devDependencies?.next) throw new Error('Unsupported framework: customize start.sh and provide static deployment output.')
    if (p.dependencies?.vite || p.devDependencies?.vite) return 'vite'
    throw new Error('Unsupported package project: customize start.sh and deployment output.')
  }
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) return 'html'
  throw new Error('No generated index.html or supported package project.')
}
export async function start(root = process.cwd()) {
  const type = projectType(root)
  const projectRoot = resolve(root)
  if (type === 'vite') {
    const stampDir = process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR || join(root, 'node_modules', '.cache')
    mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
    const stamp = join(stampDir, 'default-dependencies')
    const lock = join(root, 'package-lock.json')
    const hash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
    let old = ''
    try { old = readFileSync(stamp, 'utf8') } catch {}
    if (old !== hash || !existsSync(join(root, 'node_modules/vite'))) {
      await child('npm', [existsSync(lock) ? 'ci' : 'install', '--no-audit', '--no-fund'], { cwd: root })
      mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
      const installedHash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
      writeFileSync(stamp, installedHash)
    }
    await child(process.execPath, [join(root, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './'], { cwd: root })
    root = join(root, 'dist')
  }
  if (!existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) throw new Error('Static deployment output must contain index.html.')
  if (process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR) writeFileSync(join(process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR, 'deployment-output.json'), JSON.stringify({ project: projectRoot, directory: resolve(root) }))
  const mime = { '.html':'text/html', '.js':'application/javascript', '.css':'text/css', '.json':'application/json', '.svg':'image/svg+xml', '.png':'image/png', '.jpg':'image/jpeg', '.webp':'image/webp', '.wasm':'application/wasm', '.glb':'model/gltf-binary' }
  const clients = new Set()
  const stopWatching = watchProject(root, () => { for (const client of clients) client.write('event: change\ndata: changed\n\n') })
  const keepAlive = setInterval(() => { for (const client of clients) client.write(': keepalive\n\n') }, 20000)
  const buildWatcher = type === 'vite' ? spawn(process.execPath, [join(projectRoot, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './', '--watch'], { cwd: projectRoot, stdio: 'inherit' }) : null
  const server = createServer((req, res) => {
    try {
      const url = new URL(req.url, 'http://localhost')
      if (url.pathname === '/__omgithub/live') {
        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream', 'Cache-Control': 'no-cache', 'X-Accel-Buffering': 'no', Connection: 'keep-alive' })
        res.write(': connected\n\n')
        clients.add(res)
        req.on('close', () => clients.delete(res))
        return
      }
      const path = resolve(root, '.' + decodeURIComponent(url.pathname))
      if (path !== resolve(root) && !path.startsWith(resolve(root) + '/')) { res.writeHead(404); res.end(); return }
      const file = statSync(path).isDirectory() ? join(path, 'index.html') : path
      res.setHeader('Content-Type', mime[extname(file)] || 'application/octet-stream')
      res.setHeader('Cache-Control', url.searchParams.has('omgithub_live') ? 'no-store' : 'no-cache')
      const content = readFileSync(file)
      if (extname(file) === '.html' && url.searchParams.get('omgithub_live') === '1') {
        const html = content.toString()
        res.end(/<\/body\s*>/i.test(html) ? html.replace(/<\/body\s*>/i, `${livePreviewScript}</body>`) : html + livePreviewScript)
      } else res.end(content)
    } catch { res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not found') }
  })
  server.on('close', () => { stopWatching(); clearInterval(keepAlive); buildWatcher?.kill(); for (const client of clients) client.end() })
  server.listen(Number(process.env.PORT || 3000), '0.0.0.0')
  return server
}

## Shell timing

When writing shell scripts,
always add explicit per-command execution-time measurements between commands.
Use `/usr/bin/time -p` or a small timing helper around each meaningful command;
the outer command duration is not sufficient because it hides which step is
slow or hung. Use `/usr/bin/time` only in scripts; do not invoke it directly in
interactive shell commands.

## Ideas

Store durable implementation ideas as individual Markdown files under
`./ideas/`, using descriptive kebab-case filenames such as
`ideas/opencode-oauth-env-auth.md`.




## Links in handoffs

When a relevant URL or stable identifier exists, include a clickable Markdown
link in the user-facing response. Link GitHub issues, Actions runs, pull
requests, commits, releases, public app URLs, and Codex tasks/threads rather
than reporting only their numbers or plain text. For Codex tasks/threads, use

## OpenCode GitHub Actions

To execute an issue, create it with `OpenCode` and only mode labels explicitly requested by the user.

The workflow starts a temporary AgentsWeb SSH session,

Do not use `gh run view --log` to read logs from a running task: GitHub reports that
logs are unavailable until completion. Use `bash scripts/ssh-run-log.sh <run-id>`
for the live Actions log over SSH. Do not use tight `for` loops around `gh run list`,
which needlessly consume GitHub API rate limit.

Free OpenCode models are limited per egress IP, not per account.
Treat a local `FreeUsageLimitError` 429 as local only.
Read the runner's own `Selected model` and provider errors before blaming quota.
Use `retryAfterMs` as the reset bound.
Run repeated V2 tests with a connected provider; do not spend the free allowance on retries.

Interrupting a V2 turn before the assistant message projects leaves no stopped message to save.

To connect to an issue's live worker, find its run ID with

For real-time inspection from a live temporary SSH session, use the helper:

## Mac SSH access

The Mac private key stays at `~/.ssh/aiplay-agentsweb`. Its public key is
stored in the repository Actions secret `AGENTSWEB_SSH_PUBLIC_KEY`. The issue
commented by the workflow contains a directly usable command such as:

```sh
ssh -i ~/.ssh/aiplay-agentsweb -p <port> runner@<run-name>.agentsweb.space
```

The command works only while the corresponding Actions job is running.

## Connecting to a live OpenCode worker

Use the repository helper to discover the worker host and port from the broker
or issue comment. It uses the persistent local key `~/.ssh/aiplay-agentsweb`:

```sh
bash scripts/ssh-run-log.sh <run-id> --repo denaidark/OhMyGithub
```

For an interactive shell, reuse the host and port printed by the helper and
use the same key:

```sh

  -i ~/.ssh/aiplay-agentsweb \
```

Do not substitute the generated runner key under `sshworker/outputs/keys/`; it
can produce a misleading `Permission denied (publickey)` result. Temporary
worker SSH access ends when the Actions job and session are cleaned up. Never
print secrets while inspecting a worker.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build an interactive 3D hyperpop web experience about a female god who can create life, destroy worlds, and change everything, using Three.js.

## Requirements
- User prompt: "a female God where she can do ANYTHING @COMMENT_BODY@ EVERTHING she can create life destroy change @COMMENT_BODY@ do many things 3D hyperpop".
- Visual theme: hyperpop, Y2K/chrome, neon, goddess/altar.
- Interactions: create life, destroy, change reality; desktop and mobile support.
- User did not specify additional constraints beyond the prompt.

## Decisions
- Built as a static site with vendored Three.js r0.170.0 (no root `package.json`, because default start rejects unsupported package projects).
- Three powers: CREATE (flowers/butterflies/particles), DESTROY (shards/shockwaves/lightning/wither), CHANGE (palette cycling: Bubblegum Chrome, Acid Eden, Midnight Oracle, Solar Ecstasy).
- Procedural goddess: chrome torso/arms, dark bodysuit, holographic gown/cape, sculpted hair mass + shader ribbons, halo rings, crown, heart core, hand orb.
- Post-processing: EffectComposer, UnrealBloomPass, OutputPass, custom grade ShaderPass (chromatic aberration, glitch, grain, vignette).
- WebAudio-generated hyperpop soundtrack/SFX; starts on first gesture.
- Visual verification via `playwright-cli` at 1440x900; screenshots saved under `screenshots/`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Full project scaffold: `index.html`, `styles.css`, `js/*`, vendored Three.js addons and local fonts.
- Environment: animated sky, grid floor, chrome altar, rings, bubbles, stars, dust, beams, pillar.
- Goddess, powers, particles/shards/flowers/butterflies/lightning, audio, UI, loader, modal, responsive CSS.
- Local static server on port 3002 via tmux session `preview`.
- Fixed initial bloom whiteout by lowering bloom to `strength 0.3`, `threshold 1.35`, `radius 0.5`; reduced exposure/environment intensity; chrome changed to tinted pearl (`metalness 0.76`).
- Composition improved: goddess scaled `0.86`, camera `z=8.4`, target `y=-0.2`, altar raised to `y=-1.32` / top `-1.217`; full figure and altar now visible at 1440x900.

### Active
- Visual polish of goddess face/hair/torso and overall lighting/background.
- Close-up inspection (`screenshots/debug-closeup.png`, `debug-nopillar.png`) revealed: long thin neck, mannequin-like chrome body, dark bob hair, small face features, and a distracting thin vertical line through the crown.
- The vertical line persists even after hiding pillar/beams, so its source is still unidentified (possibly halo/gem/ribbon geometry or another object).
- Bloom is still dynamically tuned in-browser to `strength 0.1`, `threshold 2.4`, `radius 0.4`; file currently has `0.3 / 1.35 / 0.5` and still slightly washes the figure.
- Ambient flowers/butterflies on load not yet added.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Identify and remove the thin vertical line through the crown (inspect goddess child meshes; likely a stray ribbon/tube or beam edge).
2. Commit the bloom tuning to `js/post.js` (`strength ~0.1`, `threshold ~2.4`, `radius ~0.4`) and retest full scene.
3. Improve face/hair: wider head/jaw, larger almond glowing eyes, nose/lips, choker, more voluminous flowing hair, shorter neck; add hair ribbons over the mass.
4. Refine torso silhouette/corset and arms; add bracelets/glow seams to reduce mannequin look.
5. Darken/narrow sky center glow further; reduce floor grid brightness; keep pink horizon.
6. Add 3 ambient flowers + 2 butterflies on load so the altar feels alive.
7. Re-screenshot desktop 1440x900 and mobile 390x844; test CREATE/DESTROY/CHANGE and console errors.
8. Run the official capture flow (`start.sh` / `capture.sh`) and verify final images.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: page structure, importmap, HUD, console, loader, modal.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/styles.css`: full hyperpop UI, responsive layout, animations.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/main.js`: renderer/camera/lights/controls, palette actions, UI wiring, animation loop, debug `window.__OMNI`.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/goddess.js`: procedural goddess geometry/materials/animations.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/environment.js`: sky/floor/altar/bubbles/beams shaders and palette lerping.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/effects.js`: particles, shockwaves, shards, flowers, butterflies, lightning.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/post.js`: composer, bloom, grade shader.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/audio.js`: WebAudio sequencer and SFX.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/palettes.js`: four palette definitions and CSS variable application.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/utils.js`: glow texture, math helpers.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/vendor/three/`: vendored Three.js + addons (postprocessing, controls, environments, utils).
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/vendor/fonts/`: local Unbounded, Space Grotesk, Anton woff2.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/screenshots/`: current debug screenshots (`desktop-05.png`, `debug-closeup.png`, `debug-nopillar.png`, etc.).
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/start.sh` and `capture.sh`: official runtime entry points.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/README.md`: project links/branding.
